text: The government should deport undocumented immigrants who are living in the United States.
Abortion should be legal in all cases.
Private gun sales should require the same background checks as gun-store purchases.
The federal government should do much more to address climate change.
Election fraud is a major threat to the integrity of American elections.
Social media platforms should remove political misinformation.
Children under sixteen should not be allowed to use social media.
AI companies should be regulated before they release powerful models.
Social platforms should pay creators a guaranteed share of advertising revenue.
The government should strictly limit how technology companies collect personal data.
The United States should stop funding Ukraine.
The United States should remain committed to NATO even when allies spend too little on defense.
The United States should pressure Israel to accept a permanent ceasefire in Gaza.
The United States should impose higher tariffs on goods imported from China.
The United Kingdom should abolish the monarchy.
People who eat meat are doing something immoral.
Employees should be allowed to work from home whenever their jobs permit it.
Parents should not give smartphones to children before high school.
Consensual polyamorous relationships deserve the same social acceptance as monogamous relationships.
Parents should have broad freedom to homeschool their children.
Government identity documents should include gender options beyond male and female.
Transgender athletes should compete on teams matching their gender identity.
Traditional expectations of masculinity do more harm than good.
The government should do more to support religion in public life.
